$comment: Editable political-bloc definitions. Bloc membership is an editorial modelling assumption, NOT a statement of fact about any party's alignment.
Each scheme lists its blocs and a membership table. A membership entry assigns one party to one bloc for a range of election years (inclusive; omit `from`/`to` for open-ended).
Any party not assigned for a given year is shown as 'Unassigned'. Unassigned votes are reported separately and never silently folded into a bloc.
`explicitlyUnassigned` documents parties that were considered and deliberately left out, with the reason shown in the UI.
The web app also lets users override any party's bloc at runtime (Advanced > Customise blocs).

schemes.label: Core blocs — TOP excluded
schemes.description: Labour and Green against National and ACT. Te Pāti Māori joins the centre-left bloc from 2020, after it ended its confidence-and-supply relationship with National-led governments (2008–2017). TOP, NZ First and all other parties are left unassigned.

explicitlyUnassigned.reason: Has formed governments with both Labour (2017) and National (2023).
Excluded in this variant by design; see the TOP-inclusive variant.
Supported governments led by both major parties.

schemes.label: Core blocs — TOP included
schemes.description: As the core variant, but The Opportunity Party (TOP) is assigned to a bloc. By default TOP is placed in the centre-left bloc purely as a comparison assumption; switch it to the centre-right or a separate centrist bloc in the bloc settings. TOP first contested an election in 2017, so 2008–2014 results are identical to the TOP-excluded variant.

explicitlyUnassigned.reason: Has formed governments with both Labour (2017) and National (2023).
Supported governments led by both major parties.

methods.meshblock: Stats NZ 2026 meshblocks assigned to the nearest polling place, then dissolved. Follows roads, rivers and property lines; lakes and inlets stay water.
methods.voronoi: Raw Voronoi (nearest-polling-place) cells clipped to the LINZ 1:50k coastline with lakes removed.
